objective: Exploratory experiment: grow the pinwheel plane outward from one knot with no labels, the growing boundary's shape the only memory. A move adds tiles at the boundary only if every completed neighbourhood has its radius-2 code in ticket A's atlas and every incomplete one still extends to an atlas code. Measure forced moves, choices and dead ends to a declared radius, and test whether grown patches are pinwheel patches. Interpret with ticket B: whether growth can replace the hidden information that roundness needs.
status: Retired 2026-11-07, held as backlog at the owner's request to wrap up current lines rather than widen them. Outward growth of the plane one tile at a time (all growth orders, after a prior-work search on growth rules with dead surfaces and self-assembly) is a possible fresh epic; ticket B gives evidence, not yet a decisive lever, and the sphere-side GROW-COIN result found label-free growth does not remove the roundness witness there.
title: Growing the plane from one knot with the labels dropped
